State of New Mexico
Michelle Lujan Grisham
       Governor




                                      EXECUTIVE ORDER 2026-083

              AUTHORIZING ADDITIONAL EMERGENCY FUNDS FOR THE
        DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY AND EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT
                     DUE TO FLOODING ACROSS NEW MEXCO

               WHEREAS, heavy rainfall has resulted in flooding and flash flooding in multiple areas of

      New Mexico, and additional rainfall is forecast to create continued flooding conditions across the

      State;

               WHEREAS, flooding has damaged public infrastructure, disrupted transportation routes,

      threatened homes and businesses, and endangered public health and safety;

               WHEREAS, local emergency response agencies have committed substantial resources to

      flooding response operations;

               WHEREAS, flooding conditions may continue to develop in additional communities,

      requiring rapid deployment of State resources; and

               WHEREAS, this disaster is of such magnitude as to be beyond local control and requires

      the resources of the State of New Mexico to minimize economic and physical harm and to take

      actions necessary to protect the public health, safety, and welfare;

               WHEREAS, I initially declared a state of emergency due to flooding across New Mexico

      on July 23, 2026, and released emergency funding to the Department of Homeland Security and

      Emergency Management and the New Mexico National Guard; and
